# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report suspected release, signature, notarization, or update-channel
vulnerabilities through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this
repository. Do not open a public issue with exploit details or sensitive
diagnostics.

Include the affected release, asset name, observed SHA-256 digest, verification
output, potential impact, and a safe reproduction. You can expect an initial
response within seven days. Fix and disclosure timelines depend on severity
and exploitability.

If an asset's digest or signature verification fails, do not install or run it.

## Supported version

The latest published Coolstead release is supported during active development.
